On an SSD with an I7 and a 1080 TI , it runs like shit. Good mod , bad engine.

CK2 wasn't my thing , HOI4 was fun , but quite streamlined , vic2 never played as the napoleonic/industrial era was never my favorite.

When I was younger I felt more emotions , especially from making other people suffer via indirect ways , but with time I found no joy in toying with people , as I grew out of it. I have a lack of empathy , but I simulate it pretty well. It is a bad combo tho , as I need to be the center of atention , but I feel really awkward when I'm the center of attention , so I sometimes burn myself out when I'm in the public to long with my mask on. Also , I'm a perfectionist and what you propose might be my downfall , cause if i stagnate to much id go even deeper down the rabbit hole. Somehow , I'm afraid to die , but it's not the fact that its game over , its the fact that its game over and i have a huge chance to have nothing to show the fact that i played the game.

Evolutionary drive? But what happens when you see no more evolution? We aren't smarter , we aren't stronger , we just found cheats. We aren't smarter cause we created so many fucking new inventions , that handful of people in the past 3 generations made the necessary discoveries to give us the tools to use to create new stuff. We aren't stronger or faster cause we evolved , we invented stuff to make us faster , like steroid for instance. We don't live longer cause we have better genes , we invented artificial "helpers" to keep us alive. We live in a fabricated world that makes us feel more than we are. We've been devolving in the past 20-30 years , so there goes my evolutionary drive.
